description: Forensics: what did the agent see of this file, and when? Every content version the flight recorder observed (SHA-256 + git blob SHA-1, first/last seen, capture source, sessions), plus what else was in context around a focus moment. The evidence-backed answer to "why did the agent do that?" — query history instead of trusting self-report.

at.description: Focus moment (ISO timestamp). Default: last time the file was seen.

name: context_blame
